name: Yen-Yu Chen
education: National University of Tainan · Major in Digital Learning and Technology · Minor in English
intro: I am Yen-Yu Chen (Larina), a Digital Learning and Technology major with a minor in English at National University of Tainan. I bring language, teaching, user research, and system development together to understand where people need support.
transition: I began in English in 2022, added a Digital Learning and Technology minor in September 2023, and transferred to the department in September 2025. Building FitPlay helped me turn an idea into a working learning system and commit to this direction.
motivation: Teaching and research taught me to look beyond scores and completion. Experience accompanying a family member through rehabilitation drew my attention to small changes over time, everyday independence, and caregiver needs. I hope to work with professionals and users to turn these observations into research questions.
learning_focus: I am strengthening modular architecture, testing, refactoring, user interviews, and usability evaluation. I use AI and documentation to support development while remaining responsible for defining problems, checking results, and explaining design decisions.
programs: Interdisciplinary Program in Digital Technology Applications

strengths.title: Research Design
strengths.body: A 131-participant mixed-methods study connects questionnaires, interviews, theory, and interpretation.

strengths.title: Behavioral Data
strengths.body: Trial-level records and severity-aware error measures reveal what aggregate scores miss.

strengths.title: System Development
strengths.body: Six cognitive tasks, role-specific interfaces, and research modules connect needs with implementation.

strengths.title: Knowledge Translation
strengths.body: Life × Investment and 404 Daily turn abstract ideas into decisions, stories, and reflection.
